```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install claudie github

      - name: Run Claude for issue triage
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python -c "
            from claudie import Claude
            from github import Github
            import os

            claude = Claude(os.getenv('CLAUDE_API_KEY'))
            g = Github(os.getenv('GITHUB_TOKEN'))

            issue = g.get_repo('anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python').get_issue(${{ github.event.issue.number }})

            response = claude.chat(f'Please analyze this issue: {issue.title}\n{issue.body}')
            labels = response.split('\n')

            issue.edit(labels=labels)
          "
```

This GitHub Actions workflow listens for new issues being opened on the `anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python` repository. When an issue is opened, it triggers a job to run a Python script that uses the Claude API to analyze the issue and suggest appropriate labels. The suggested labels are then applied to the issue using the GitHub API. Make sure to set the `CLAUDE_API_KEY` secret in your repository settings to authenticate requests to the Claude API.
